name: Kamisu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kamisu city emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kamisu, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 26 December 1977; the emblem dates from 24 March 1970.

features.role: Kamisu city emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings enclosing a ring
